name_vi: Tấm kê nồi cách mặt bàn
description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A square bamboo-ringed woven pad rests on four short solid feet. Side: The feet create a visible air gap beneath the thick woven center. Rear: The underside has crossed solid bamboo rails supporting the pad. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
